about: Every drip-ai config key with its built-in value; a key not listed here is refused. A null value means the engine derives it. type: int, number, bool, string, json, list[string], list[region], or enum:a|b (list[enum:a|b] for lists); choices limits an int; min and max bound a number. nullable lets a layer set null. env names the one DRIP_AI_* variable that sets the key.

regions.doc: Regions a race may use, in preference order; derived: the home region

race.max_lanes.doc: Endpoints a race may hold at once, across every region

race.max_spend_per_hour_usd.doc: Ceiling on the sum of the lanes' hourly list prices; null sets none

race.hours.doc: Wall-clock cap on a race with no winner

race.classes.doc: GPU classes a race may use; derived: every class whose GPUs hold the model

race.instance_types.doc: Instance types a race may use (ml. names); derived: every type of the raced classes

clients.link.doc: Clients a tunnel links; Codex and Claude Code only when listed, [] for none

clients.opencode.set_default_model.doc: Whether linking opencode also sets its top-level model

ports.base.doc: First local port a tunnel serves on

ports.range.doc: Ports from ports.base that serve and doctor consider

ports.auto.doc: Whether serve takes the next free port when another process holds ports.base

lifecycle.protect.doc: Resource names doctor and cleanup never touch

notify.argv.doc: Command a race runs with one message appended, when it needs you; null notifies nobody

learn.enabled.doc: Whether plans read and races write the local learning store

serve.weights.doc: Where the server loads weights from: the region's models bucket, or Hugging Face at the fetched revision

serve.max_model_len.doc: Context window; derived from the model and the memory left for the KV cache

serve.min_context.doc: Smallest derived context window the plan accepts

serve.target_sequences.doc: Full-length sequences the KV cache should hold at once

serve.tensor_parallel_size.doc: GPUs per server; derived: the instance's GPU count

serve.dcp.doc: Decode context parallel size; derived: the smallest that fits

serve.kv_cache_dtype.doc: KV cache precision; derived: fp8 when the runtime supports the model's fp8 layout

serve.mtp_tokens.doc: MTP speculative tokens, 0 for none; derived: 1 when the model has draft layers and the runtime supports MTP

serve.prefix_caching.doc: Prefix caching; derived: on when supported

serve.async_scheduling.doc: Async scheduling; derived: on when supported

serve.max_num_batched_tokens.doc: Batched tokens per step; derived: 8192 when supported

serve.kv_offload_gib.doc: Host RAM for KV offload in GiB, 0 for none; derived: min(200, 10% of host RAM) when supported

serve.gpu_memory_utilization.doc: Share of GPU memory vLLM may use

serve.fit_margin.doc: Headroom the KV pool must keep above the tokens it is sized for

serve.overhead_fraction.doc: Modeled share of GPU memory for activations and graphs, until a measured value replaces it

serve.repetition_penalty.doc: Default repetition_penalty the server applies, overriding the checkpoint's generation_config.json (some ship 1.1, which degrades long reasoning); null keeps the checkpoint's

serve.extra_args.doc: vLLM flags added last; they win on a flag the plan also sets

sagemaker.inference_ami_version.doc: Endpoint inference AMI; null lets SageMaker choose

sagemaker.provision_timeout_seconds.doc: How long SageMaker looks for an instance in a lane's pool

sagemaker.volume_size_gb.doc: Endpoint EBS volume; null for types with local NVMe

capacity.duration_hours.doc: Capacity-block length capacity search asks for

capacity.window_days.doc: How far ahead capacity search looks for a block start

disk.min_free_gb.doc: Free GB this machine must keep before a docker pull, image build, or large download; drip-ai refuses below it, 0 to skip

capacity.include_ultraservers.doc: Whether capacity search shows u-* UltraServer offerings
